items.label: Advertise
items.title: 📢 Promote Your Brand on FreeTV Garden
items.text:
Promote your **website, product, app, business, YouTube channel or social media page** to FreeTV Garden visitors.

🇮🇳 **India: from ₹29** · 🌍 **International: from $2**

Choose your ad placement and duration below.
items.more:
**INDIA — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard listing — ₹29: regular position in the Sponsored panel.
• Featured listing — ₹59: higher priority in the panel.
• Top placement — ₹99: pinned at the top of the Sponsored panel.

**INTERNATIONAL — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard listing — $2 USD.
• Featured listing — $2 USD.
• Top placement — $2 USD.

**WEEKEND & HIGH-DEMAND DATES**

India: Standard ₹39 · Featured ₹69 · Top placement ₹99.

International: starting at $2 USD per 24 hours, subject to confirmation.

**HOW TO BOOK**

1. Send your website or social media link, or your ad banner and text.
2. Choose your target audience, placement and preferred start date.
3. We confirm availability, final price and duration before payment.

**PLEASE NOTE**

All plans are for 24 hours. Top placement means priority at the top of the Sponsored panel, subject to availability. Ads are shown to visitors who open the panel; views, clicks or sales are not guaranteed. Ads must be reviewed and approved before publication.
